description:
Market-wide funding scan over Hyperliquid, dYdX v4 and Paradex perps: pass symbols (watchlist, up to 25, e.g. BTC,ETH,SOL) or universe=all (every market above min_oi_usd, default $1M). Returns the highest and lowest funding (APR), the widest cross-venue funding spreads, the market-wide OI-weighted funding and share of markets with positive funding, with a per-asset label. Paid only. Not financial advice.
Not for: one asset in depth (perp_positioning).

[PerpRadar via YourAITools MCP Hub] No free tier (paid route only). Paid: scan $0.02 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.

min_oi_usd.description: Universe mode: minimum open interest in USD per venue market (default 1000000)

symbols.description: Comma-separated tickers (max 25), e.g. BTC,ETH,SOL. Either symbols or universe=all is required.

universe.description: all = scan every market above min_oi_usd

name: perp_funding_scan
